claim_one_line: The programme's genericity controls were family members: m003 is commensurable with m004 (index 12 in PSL(2,O_-3)), and m129 -- proposed by cc as the non-commensurable fix -- is index 12 in PSL(2,O_-1), the SILVER's class-mate. The family has TWO rows and the repo has no null non-commensurable with both. Also verified: m003 IS amphichiral (B296 calls it a non-amphichiral control), and by Reid no knot complement is commensurable with 4_1, so B438/B440/B443's '4_1 ~ 5_2 commensurability class' is backwards -- an error that conceals genericity rather than creating it.
